visual_name: Day in the life, part forty eight: unc (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js skate park on a sunny afternoon (a concrete halfpipe with curved walls and coping, a ledge, a rail, a chain fence, a back wall of painted shapes, trees, his white work van for a made-up heating firm), three box-built teen skaters (one pumping the halfpipe, one carving behind, one on the ledge), box-built boiler fitter of fifty four with grey hair and beard, navy overalls, a tool belt, a red cap that spins backwards, a wrench, a skateboard that rides the halfpipe surface, phone sheets for deals that all say ages 18-24 / the brand chat (this is for Gen Z) / YourBrand age group (18-24, 25-40, 40+) and Find deals with the real fit line, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 41.0 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a fifty-four-year-old boiler fitter wants brand deals, but every one says ages 18 to 24. So he wears his cap backwards, says no cap, says a boiler is bussin, and buys a skateboard. The skateboard wins: he drops into the bowl and lands flat at the bottom. The brand says it is for Gen Z. Then YourBrand: his age group set once (40+), and Find deals shows "Not a fit for your profile (age group)" before he applies, not after he falls. The skaters call him unc. He doesn't know what it means. He loves it.
